title: Bug: test_dpu_console does not work
author: JibinBao
body:
### Is it platform specific

SmartSwitch

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

In the test_dpu_console, the following command can work when running it on dut directly by terminal, but it  does not work when using ansible.shell() in script
`sudo python -c "import pexpect; child = pexpect.spawn('python /usr/local/bin/dpu-tty.py -n dpu1'); child.expect(r' '); child.sendline('\r\r'); child.expect(r' '); child.sendline('exit\rexit\r'); child.expect(r'sonic login: '); print(child.after.decode()); child.close()"`



### Steps to Reproduce

run test_dpu_console on smartswitch

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The command of  logining in console raise exception. 
Login in console should succeed.

linkedPullRequests.body: ### Description of PR Summary: Fixes # https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/18054 The fix works because of addition of the following lines in the command: > 'child.expect(r\'Terminal\'); ' > 'child.sendline(\'\');' Because of the difference in the serial console application between the platforms, on mellanox platforms we need to wait until the Terminal text is displayed and input entry key before adding the text, so this fix is required for mellanox devices only.
